lines.en: label chikaspecial45:
scene noonsky
I tap on Chika’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Chika 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I know she’s normally working around this time but, based on what may be a change of heart centered around a hopeful change in income...that might not be the case any longer.
lines.zh: 我知道这个点她平常在上班，不过看她好像因为「收入有望变好」而改了主意……说不定已经不是那样了。

lines.en: I doubt she’s made any major moves yet. I feel like she would have told me if she did. Or, at the bare minimum, sent me a picture of her with at least part of the costume on.
lines.zh: 我猜她还没做什么大动作。她要是做了，应该会告诉我。再不济，也会发张她至少穿上部分制服的照片给我。

lines.en: She’s sent me nothing at all.
lines.zh: 可她什么都没发。

lines.en: Which is why I’m now reaching out to her — so she can be reminded of what is important.
lines.zh: 所以我现在主动联系她——好让她想起什么才重要。

lines.en: Me.
lines.zh: 我。

lines.en: : Helloooo?
: Hey. Are you working right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你现在在上班吗？

lines.en: : I am not! I took today off to hang out with Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 没在！我今天请假，跟 Tsubasa 一起玩。

lines.en: : I see...Just to satisfy my own curiosity though, are you still employed by the clothing place? Or have you moved onto bigger, pinker things yet?
lines.zh: : 这样……不过纯粹满足一下我的好奇心：你还在那家服装店干吗？还是已经跳槽去做「更大、更粉」的事业了？

lines.en: : I am still employed by the clothing place. I haven’t followed up with Uta yet. But if you’re that desperate to see me in the uniform, I can ask her if I can borrow one.
lines.zh: : 我还在服装店干。还没跟 Uta 跟进。不过你要是那么想看我穿制服，我可以问问她能不能借我一套。

lines.en: : That would be greatly appreciated. Is this thing with Tsubasa something I can join in on? Or are you two being a weird, unrelated mother-daughter couple again?
lines.zh: : 那就太感谢了。你跟 Tsubasa 这事我能加入吗？还是你们俩又在当那种「没有血缘的怪母女档」？

lines.en: : You can drop by if you want! We’re at my place.
lines.zh: : 你想来就来呀！我们在我家。

lines.en: : Not sure how much fun you’ll have, though. We’re kind of just talking and making sure the kids don’t accidentally take over the world.
lines.zh: : 不过你不一定觉得多好玩。我们就是随便聊聊，顺便看着点俩孩子别一不小心统治世界。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll come meet you then. It’s not like I have anything else going on.
lines.zh: : 那我去找你吧。反正我也没别的事。

lines.en: : Cool! I’ll let everybody know. I’m sure they’ll all be happy to see you.
lines.zh: : 好耶！我跟大家说。我肯定他们见到你都高兴。

lines.en: : Doubtful.
lines.zh: : 不见得。

lines.en: : Oh, shut it. I love you and I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 哦，闭嘴。我爱你，一会儿见。

lines.en: : Yeah...you too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也爱你。

lines.en: scene black
As you may have noticed, I’ve given up on fighting the boyfriend thing — even mentally.
lines.zh: 你可能注意到了，我已经放弃抗拒「男朋友」这个身份了——连在心里都不再抗拒。

lines.en: I’ve waited too long at this point to say anything about it and, even if Chika only started believing it due to me not making my stance on relationships clear enough, I’m here now and...I don’t want to leave.
lines.zh: 事到如今我拖得太久、没法再开口澄清了。而且，就算 Chika 当初只是因为我没把「我对感情的态度」说清楚才开始这么以为，我现在也在这儿了……我不想走。

lines.en: It’s by that metric, however, that I realize I’m dating a ton of people.
lines.zh: 不过按这个标准，我才意识到：我在跟一大堆人「约会」。

lines.en: Some of them understand my stance a little better than others, sure- but when it comes down to it...I’m not really anything more than the student body’s universal boyfriend.
lines.zh: 她们中有些人确实比别人更懂我的态度——但说到底……我不过是全校学生共享的「万能男友」。

lines.en: All that’s left to do is check off the rest of the boxes pertaining to those I haven’t slept with yet and further diminish the meaning of the word “boyfriend” until it's no longer worth it to anyone.
lines.zh: 接下来要做的，就是把那些「还没睡过」的格子一个个勾掉，把「男朋友」这个词的意义消磨到对谁都不再值钱。

lines.en: I’ll get there.
lines.zh: 我会做到的。

lines.en: But before that, there’s somewhere else I need to go.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，我得先去另一个地方。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback1
A place where I am always welcome — with paperthin walls and a foundation I’m sure is already in the process of crumbling.
lines.zh: 一个永远欢迎我的地方——墙壁薄如纸，地基肯定也已经开始塌了。

lines.en: Much like the rest of the buildings in this half of town, this one surely doesn’t have much time left.
lines.zh: 跟这半座城的其他建筑一样，这栋楼肯定也撑不了多久了。

lines.en: I have somewhere else I could take her.
lines.zh: 我原本有别的地方可以带她去。

lines.en: It’s a place that’s still a secret to most, and I could make it Chika’s secret as well if I was anywhere near a good person.
lines.zh: 那地方对大多数人来说还是个秘密。要是我算得上半个好人，我也可以让它成为 Chika 的秘密。

lines.en: But I’m not.
lines.zh: 可我不是。

lines.en: And so I’ll wait for her new mother to do it instead because it will spare me a slightly difficult talk.
lines.zh: 所以我会等她那位「新妈妈」去做——这样我就能省掉一场有点难开口的谈话。

lines.en: : Hey! You hungry? Tsubasa’s making curry.
lines.zh: : 嘿！你饿吗？Tsubasa 在做咖喱。

lines.en: : Look at me, cooking when it’s not even a competition. It’s like university all over again.
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧我，又不是比赛还在做饭。简直跟大学时一样。

lines.en: : I’m fine. You two can eat without me.
lines.zh: : 我没事。你们俩吃吧，别管我。

lines.en: : Are you sure? We made enough for like ten people so there would be plenty of leftovers for tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我们做的够十个人吃，这样明天还有好多剩的。

lines.en: : Follow up with me tomorrow then. In the meantime, what are Chinami and Tsukasa arguing about? They look...passionate.
lines.zh: : 那明天再找我。对了，Chinami 和 Tsukasa 在吵什么？看着……挺投入的。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback2
: Chinami! What’s Tsukasa trying to convince you to do now?!
lines.zh: : Chinami！Tsukasa 又想说服你干嘛？！

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t even know! Tsukasa just keeps yelling letters at her!
lines.zh: : Chinami 都不知道！Tsukasa 就一直冲她喊字母！

lines.en: : I’m trying to teach you the difference between CEO, CRO, CMO, CTO, CFO, COO, CSO, CHRO, and CIO! This is elementary level stuff, Chinami! You need to know this as my partner!
lines.zh: : 我在教你 CEO、CRO、CMO、CTO、CFO、COO、CSO、CHRO、CIO 的区别！这是最基础的，Chinami！作为我的搭档，你必须懂！

lines.en: : See?!
lines.zh: : 看见没？！

lines.en: : Yes! C! For Chief! Now, tell me what the other letters stand for!
lines.zh: : 对！C 是 Chief（首席）！现在告诉我其他字母什么意思！

lines.en: scene chikasflashback3
: And that’s basically why we stopped paying attention.
lines.zh: : 我们差不多就是这样放弃关注的。

lines.en: : Oh, Tsukasa and her acronyms. I’m just glad she’s outgrown speaking entirely through abbreviations. That was quite a difficult month for me.
lines.zh: : 哦，Tsukasa 和她那一套缩略语。我倒是庆幸她终于不再全程只用缩写说话了。那个月我可难熬了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m good not taking any part in their conversation and will gladly just continue conversing with you two instead.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她们的对话我就不掺和了，我宁愿继续跟你们俩聊。

lines.en: : So long as that doesn’t pertain to business as well, I mean. Because if you two are being anywhere near as boring as them, I’m out of here.
lines.zh: : 我是说，只要你们聊的也跟「商业」无关就行。要是你们俩也跟她们一样无聊，我可就走了。

lines.en: : I was actually just telling Tsubasa about my mom.
lines.zh: : 我刚才其实在跟 Tsubasa 讲我妈的事。

lines.en: : Without crying?
lines.zh: : 没哭？

lines.en: scene chikasflashback4
: I don’t always cry when talking about her, you know. I have plenty of good memories to talk about too.
lines.zh: : 我又不是每次讲她都哭，好不好。我也有好多开心的回忆可以讲。

lines.en: : Then why haven’t you ever told me about them?
lines.zh: : 那你以前怎么从来没跟我讲过？

lines.en: : Becaaaaause it’s not an exciting conversation topic and we’re normally doing...other stuff?
lines.zh: : 因为——那又不是什么带劲的话题，而且我们平常都在干……别的事嘛？

lines.en: : Well, I see there’s no need to fully censor yourself around Tsubasa anymore.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来在 Tsubasa 面前你确实不用再遮遮掩掩了。

lines.en: if chikalust25 == True:
scene chikasflashback5
: After what I saw during your Halloween party? No, there’s no need for such formalities anymore.
lines.zh: : 在你们万圣节派对上看到那番景象之后？是没必要再讲那些虚礼了。

lines.en: : Arf...
: Arf indeed.
lines.zh: : 确实是「汪」。

lines.en: else:
scene chikasflashback5
: To this day, I can no longer walk down the halls of the ryokan without hearing phantom noises that are quite similar to those you two made when you stayed there.
lines.zh: : 到今天，我走在旅馆的走廊里，都还能听见跟你们俩那晚留宿时发出的动静极为相似的「幻听」。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
: I apologize for our actions somehow haunting your halls. But also, I regret nothing.
lines.zh: : 我为我们的动静「萦绕」你的走廊道歉。不过，我一点都不后悔。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback6
: Are you like, actually cool hearing about her though? It won’t be weird for you?
lines.zh: : 不过你听了她的事，真的不介意吗？不会让你别扭吧？

lines.en: : Why would it be weird?
lines.zh: : 为什么会别扭？

lines.en: : I don’t know...You never really talk about your parents, so I figured there might be some hostility there or-
lines.zh: : 不知道……你从来不怎么提你父母，所以我猜你可能有点抵触，或者——

lines.en: : There’s nothing. Just finish whatever story you were telling Tsubasa and I’ll fill in the gaps.
lines.zh: : 没什么。你接着把刚才跟 Tsubasa 讲的故事讲完，缺的我自己补。

lines.en: : You’re positive?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : I’m positive.
lines.zh: : 我确定。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback7
: Okay.
: Then...
scene black
scene chikasflashback8
: It was in this very kitchen...on curry night...
lines.zh: : 就是在这间厨房里……一个吃咖喱的晚上……

lines.en: : Mom! Have you seen my bracelet anywhere?
lines.zh: : 妈！你看见我的手链了吗？

lines.en: : Which one, Chika? You have many, many bracelets.
lines.zh: : 哪一条，Chika？你有好多好多条手链。

lines.en: : The one with the beads! That we got from the flea market near the beach!
lines.zh: : 带珠子的那条！就是我们在海边跳蚤市场买的！

lines.en: scene chikasflashback9
: Didn’t you say you were going to take good care of that one? Taking care of something means not losing it, you know.
lines.zh: : 你不是说要好好保管那条吗？「好好保管」可包括「别弄丢」，知道吗。

lines.en: : I didn’t lose-
lines.zh: : 我没弄——

lines.en: : Oh. Here it is.
lines.zh: : 哦。在这儿。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback10
: Told you I didn't lose it.
lines.zh: : 我就说没丢吧。

lines.en: : It was in Chinami’s playpen. It must have fallen off when I was playing with her.
lines.zh: : 在 Chinami 的游戏围栏里。准是我陪她玩的时候掉的。

lines.en: : Please be more careful around your sister, Chika. She’s at that age where she wants to put everything in her mouth and I’m pretty sure that bracelet isn’t edible.
lines.zh: : 在你妹妹身边小心点，Chika。她正是什么都往嘴里塞的年纪，我敢说那条手链不能吃。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback11
: Do you know when she’s coming home?
lines.zh: : 你知道她什么时候回来吗？

lines.en: : Why? Do you miss her?
lines.zh: : 怎么？想她了？

lines.en: : Not really. I’m just wondering.
lines.zh: : 才没有。我只是随便问问。

lines.en: : Are you just too embarrassed to admit you miss her?
lines.zh: : 你是不好意思承认想她了吧？

lines.en: scene chikasflashback12
: No. I already told you. I’m just wondering.
lines.zh: : 没有。我说了。我只是随便问问。

lines.en: : She’s been gone for a while and I just want to know when she’ll be back. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 她去了好久了，我就想知道她什么时候回来。仅此而已。

lines.en: : Well, regardless of whether or not you’re embarrassed, which you are, I’m glad you’re “wondering.”
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管你承不承认「不好意思」——你确实是——你能「惦记」她，我很高兴。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback13
: It’s your job to look out for her, after all. And having a responsible girl like you as my backup takes a huge load off of my mind, Chika.
lines.zh: : 毕竟照看她本来也是你的责任。有你这么个懂事的姑娘当我的「后盾」，我可省心多了，Chika。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback14
: Of course! You know I’d do anything I can to help! And I won’t even ask for a raise on my allowance in exchange!
lines.zh: : 那当然！只要能帮上忙，我什么都愿意做！而且我还不拿「涨零花钱」当交换条件！

lines.en: : What do you want now?
lines.zh: : 你又想要什么了？

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’re talking about, Mommy. There isn’t anything I want. And if there is, it’s definitely not a gold necklace like yours.
lines.zh: : 我听不懂你在说什么，妈妈。我什么都不想要。就算有，也绝对不是像你那样的金项链。

lines.en: : This isn’t real gold, Chika. How many times do I have to tell you that?
lines.zh: : 这不是真金，Chika。我得跟你说多少遍？

lines.en: : Yeah, but it looks gold and I want to look more like you.
lines.zh: : 可它看着像金的，而且我想跟你更像一点。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback15
: Between your hair, your clothes, your attitude...you’re basically already me, Chika. A necklace isn’t going to bring you any closer.
lines.zh: : 你的头发、你的穿着、你的脾气……你基本上已经是我了，Chika。一条项链改变不了什么。

lines.en: : You know I don’t have any money to give you anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正你也知道我没钱给你。

lines.en: : Can I at least use your makeup kit?
lines.zh: : 那我至少能用用你的化妆盒吗？

lines.en: scene chikasflashback16
: Absolutely not and you are grounded for even asking.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。你敢开口，就罚你禁足。

lines.en: : Pleeeeease? I’m almost nine years old. I should be allowed by now.
lines.zh: : 拜托——嘛？我都快九岁了。早该让我用了。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback17
: Oh, my beautiful daughter...
lines.zh: : 哦，我的宝贝女儿……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : But why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么嘛？！

lines.en: : Because I said so.
lines.zh: : 因为我说了不行。

lines.en: : But Mom-
lines.zh: : 可是妈——

lines.en: scene chikasflashback18
: In regard to the youngest member of the Chosokabe family, I estimate another...three hours until she’s back from her check-up at the hospital.
lines.zh: : 至于长宗我部家最小的成员，我估计还要……三个小时，她才能从医院检查回来。

lines.en: : That long? What are they even doing over there?
lines.zh: : 那么久？他们在那边到底干嘛呢？

lines.en: scene chikasflashback19
: Blood work. More tests to figure out what’s wrong so we can start making her better.
lines.zh: : 验血。再做些检查，弄清到底哪儿出了问题，好开始把她治好。

lines.en: : Do they not have enough of her blood already? How much more do they need?
lines.zh: : 他们抽她的血还不够吗？还要多少？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Nobody does. But all we can do is keep listening to what the doctors say since they know better than us.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。谁也不知道。但我们只能一直听医生的，因为他们比我们懂。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback20
: I wish it was me instead.
lines.zh: : 真希望生病的是我。

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: : Why can’t they take my blood? We’re sisters. It’s the same, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 他们干嘛不能抽我的血？我们是姐妹。血是一样的，对吧？

lines.en: scene chikasflashback21
: You know it doesn’t work that way. You’re smarter than this.
lines.zh: : 你知道不是那么回事。你比这聪明。

lines.en: : Chinami’s special. Which means she needs special care.
lines.zh: : Chinami 是「特殊」的。也就是说，她需要特殊的照顾。

lines.en: : We can’t even go with her, though? Why do we have to stay here?
lines.zh: : 可我们连陪她去都不行？为什么非得待在这儿？

lines.en: scene chikasflashback22
: Because it would only make things harder.
lines.zh: : 因为那样只会更麻烦。

lines.en: : If we go with her, we’ll get questioned. She looks just like us and we don’t have enough money for her tests.
lines.zh: : 我们要是陪她去，就会被人盘问。她长得跟我们太像，而她的检查费我们又出不起。

lines.en: : But people aren’t going to question your friend bringing her when they look nothing alike?
lines.zh: : 可你朋友带她去，长得一点都不像，人家就不会盘问吗？

lines.en: : Nope! Because my friend has connections at the hospital and has been pretending Chinami is her daughter for two years now.
lines.zh: : 不会！因为我朋友在医院有关系，这两年一直假装 Chinami 是她女儿。

lines.en: : No one’s going to question her at this point...and we need her insurance.
lines.zh: : 到这地步已经没人会怀疑她了……而且我们需要她的医保。

lines.en: : In fact, I doubt anyone would question her in general. She’s a little intimidating sometimes. But it’s better to be safe than sorry.
lines.zh: : 其实，我觉得一般人都不敢盘问她。她有时候挺有威慑力的。不过，小心驶得万年船。

lines.en: : It still feels weird...
lines.zh: : 可还是觉得怪怪的……

lines.en: scene chikasflashback23
: That’s because it’s extremely illegal! But sometimes, drastic measures must be taken to ensure that-
lines.zh: : 因为这是严重违法的！可有时候，为了确保——，就不得不采取非常手段。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback24
: Aghahhck!!! Mnnfghckkck! HMmf! Ngchghchkl!
: Mom?! Are you okay?!
lines.zh: : 妈？！你没事吧？！

lines.en: scene chikasflashback25
: Mgh...fhmhckh....
: Purse...
: Which one?!
lines.zh: : 哪个？！

lines.en: : The...knockoff Louis...
lines.zh: : 那个……山寨的……LV……

lines.en: : I know that! I meant which medication?!
lines.zh: : 我知道！我是问哪种药？！

lines.en: : In...haler...
lines.zh: : 吸……吸入器……

lines.en: : Okay!
scene black
: Okay! Okay! Okay!
lines.zh: : 好！好！好！

lines.en: : Hang in there! I’ve got it!
lines.zh: : 撑住！我拿到了！

lines.en: scene chikasflashback26
: She lasted a few more years after that.
lines.zh: : 那之后，她又撑了几年。

lines.en: : It probably could have been longer if we were wealthy but, that’s...just the hand you’re dealt sometimes.
lines.zh: : 要是我们有钱，她或许能撑更久，可……人生有时候发给你的就是这么一副牌。

lines.en: : On the bright side, she got to keep all of her hair. And she died prettier than most people ever live.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，她的头发一根没掉。而且她走的时候，比大多数人活着的时候都美。

lines.en: : Oh, Chika...you poor thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，Chika……可怜的孩子。

lines.en: : So much for happy memories. That was fucking miserable.
lines.zh: : 「开心的回忆」算白讲了。这也太惨了。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback27
: It wasn’t, though.
lines.zh: : 不惨啊。

lines.en: : Like, yeah, the way it really ended was...but I learned so much from her. And if it weren’t for her teaching me all about responsibility, I have no idea where I’d even be today.
lines.zh: : 是，结局确实……可她教会了我太多。要不是她教我什么是「责任」，我真不知道自己今天会在哪儿。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback28
: In hindsight, it was pretty clear she knew she wasn’t going to last forever.
lines.zh: : 现在回头看，她其实很清楚自己撑不了多久。

lines.en: : In fact, I probably believed that back then as well but just chose to ignore it because I was too afraid.
lines.zh: : 其实，我那会儿多半也隐约明白，只是太害怕，故意不去想。

lines.en: : I think that’s why she was as strict with me as she was...why she always called me her “backup.”
lines.zh: : 我想，这就是为什么她对我那么严……为什么她老叫我「后盾」。

lines.en: : It was only a matter of time until it was my turn.
lines.zh: : 轮到我接手，只是时间问题。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback29
: It’s my turn now.
lines.zh: : 现在轮到我了。

lines.en: : But she’s still watching over me, wherever she is.
lines.zh: : 但她还在某个地方看着我。

lines.en: : And she can’t tell me I’m not allowed to use her makeup kit anymore.
lines.zh: : 而且，她再也不能管着我不许用她的化妆盒了。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback30
: Sincerest apologies! I couldn’t hold back any longer!
lines.zh: : 万分抱歉！我再也忍不住了！

lines.en: : Hey! Hey, hey, hey! It’s okay! You don’t have to cry! That was a hopeful, happy ending! I’m okay now!
lines.zh: : 嘿！嘿、嘿、嘿！没事的！你不用哭！那是个有希望的圆满结局！我现在好着呢！

lines.en: : Well, I’m not!
lines.zh: : 可我不好！

lines.en: scene chikasflashback31
: Oh no! What will become of Chinami when Tsukasa’s mommy kills her big sister?!
lines.zh: : 哦不！等 Tsukasa 的妈妈杀了她姐姐，Chinami 可怎么办？！

lines.en: : You can come live in my house. Your house sucks anyway.
lines.zh: : 你可以搬来我家住。反正你家也破。

lines.en: : You can both come live with me right now!
lines.zh: : 你们俩现在就能搬来跟我住！

lines.en: scene chikasflashback32
: Yaaaaaay!
: Woah, no way! I couldn’t do that to you! That’d be, like...totally unfair!
lines.zh: : 哇，不行！我不能那么对你！那也太……太不公平了！

lines.en: : But it wasn’t unfair having me buy multiple phones for you?
lines.zh: : 可我给你买了好几部手机，那就公平了？

lines.en: : Don’t even think of putting that on the same level as this, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 别把那个跟这个相提并论，Sensei！

lines.en: : Let’s go kill pigs to celebrate!
lines.zh: : 我们去杀猪庆祝吧！

lines.en: : Okay! Chinami goes first!
lines.zh: : 好耶！Chinami 先来！

lines.en: scene chikasflashback33
: God your boobs are so fucking big.
lines.zh: : 天哪你的胸也太大了。

lines.en: : You can cry into them. It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 你可以往里头哭。没事的。

lines.en: : Crying is...kind of the last thing I want to do right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在……最不想干的就是哭。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback34
: Hah...I can’t remember the last time I shed real tears and not just fake ones at all of those charity drives.
lines.zh: : 哈……我都不记得上次真掉眼泪是什么时候了——那些慈善活动上的全是装的。

lines.en: : Like I said...you don’t have to cry. I’m fine now.
lines.zh: : 我说了……你不用哭。我现在好着呢。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback35
: Chika, I was serious about what I said. There is plenty of room at the manor for both you and your sister.
lines.zh: : Chika，我刚才说的话是认真的。宅子里有的是地方，容得下你和你妹妹。

lines.en: : I know...and thanks, Tsubasa. Really. But I have more control over Chinami’s health while I’m here and...
lines.zh: : 我知道……谢谢你，Tsubasa。真的。可我留在这儿，更能管住 Chinami 的身体，而且……

lines.en: scene chikasflashback36
: I think both of us still have a lot of...attachment to this place. I might have moved on and grown up, but...I don’t know if I’m ready to leave that behind just yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们俩对这里都还……割舍不下。我也许已经走出来、长大了，可……我不知道自己准备好彻底告别了没有。

lines.en: : Well, my offer will remain open indefinitely. And should you change your mind or require any assistance at all, please just let me know.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我的提议长期有效。哪天你改主意了，或者需要任何帮助，尽管开口。

lines.en: scene chikasflashback37
: Of course...thank you, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢你，Tsubasa。

lines.en: : For everything.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你做的一切。

lines.en: scene black
I can’t help but feel like it may have been better if I didn’t come here today.
lines.zh: 我忍不住觉得，今天也许不来更好。

lines.en: It was “nice” finally getting to hear more about Chika’s mother, don’t get me wrong-
lines.zh: 能多听点 Chika 母亲的事确实「挺好」，别误会——

lines.en: But it seems to me like I may have interrupted a moment that would have just...been better without me.
lines.zh: 但在我看来，我可能打断了一个……没有我反而更好的时刻。

lines.en: While Tsubasa cried her eyes out and Chika did all she could to cheer her up, I kind of just...stood there.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 哭得稀里哗啦，Chika 想尽办法哄她，而我差不多就……杵在那儿。

lines.en: I mean, what else was I supposed to do?
lines.zh: 我是说，我还能干嘛？

lines.en: I couldn’t help.
lines.zh: 我帮不上忙。

lines.en: I couldn’t relate.
lines.zh: 我也无法感同身受。

lines.en: My presence was nothing more than an unnecessary afterthought.
lines.zh: 我的存在，不过是个多余的陪衬。

lines.en: Which is why it feels so wrong to still be splashing around in puddles even after the rain subsides.
lines.zh: 所以，雨都停了还在水洼里扑腾，感觉才这么不对劲。

$ chika_love += 1
